sections.skill: Identify the tax forms workers receive and file

questions.prompt: Kayla had a part-time job at a store. Which form will her employer send showing her wages and taxes withheld for the year?
questions.intro: At tax time, you gather forms that report your income: Form W-2 from each employer (wages and taxes withheld); Forms 1099 from others, such as 1099-NEC for contract work, 1099-INT for interest, and 1099-DIV for dividends. You then file Form 1040, the federal individual income tax return.
sources: IRS: Form 1040 is the individual income tax return; employers issue Form W-2; payers issue Forms 1099 for other income. (https://www.irs.gov/forms-instructions)

questions.prompt: Ravi did freelance graphic design for a business. Which form might the business send him?
questions.intro: Businesses may report payments to independent contractors on Form 1099-NEC (nonemployee compensation).
questions.feedback: Contractor pay is reported on Form 1099-NEC.
sources: IRS: Form 1040 is the individual income tax return; employers issue Form W-2; payers issue Forms 1099 for other income. (https://www.irs.gov/forms-instructions)

questions.prompt: Which form is the federal individual income tax return itself?
questions.feedback: Form 1040 is the return; W-2s and 1099s are information forms.
sources: IRS: Form 1040 is the individual income tax return; employers issue Form W-2; payers issue Forms 1099 for other income. (https://www.irs.gov/forms-instructions)

questions.prompt: Kayla's W-2 shows Box 1 wages of $8,400 and Box 2 federal income tax withheld of $310. What does the $310 represent?

choices.text: Her total tax bill for the year, which she must pay again
A refund already sent to her
Federal income tax already paid through withholding

questions.correct_answer: Federal income tax already paid through withholding
questions.intro: Form W-2 boxes: Box 1 shows taxable wages; Box 2 shows federal income tax withheld; other boxes show Social Security and Medicare wages and taxes, and state amounts.
questions.feedback: Box 2 is federal income tax withheld; it counts toward her tax when she files.
sources: IRS: Form 1040 is the individual income tax return; employers issue Form W-2; payers issue Forms 1099 for other income. (https://www.irs.gov/forms-instructions)

questions.prompt: Kayla earned $45 of interest from her savings account. Which form reports it?
questions.feedback: Bank interest is reported on Form 1099-INT.
sources: IRS: Form 1040 is the individual income tax return; employers issue Form W-2; payers issue Forms 1099 for other income. (https://www.irs.gov/forms-instructions)

sections.skill: Information forms versus the tax return
sections.relationship: Students must see W-2s and 1099s as inputs to the 1040, not separate bills.

questions.prompt: What does an "information form" like a W-2 do?

choices.text: It is a bill that must be paid by April
It reports income and amounts withheld

questions.correct_answer: It reports income and amounts withheld
questions.intro: Information forms report income to you and the IRS. You use them to complete your return.
questions.feedback: Information forms report numbers used on your return.
sources: IRS: Form 1040 is the individual income tax return; employers issue Form W-2; payers issue Forms 1099 for other income. (https://www.irs.gov/forms-instructions)

questions.prompt: Who files Form 1040?
questions.intro: Each person (or married couple) files their own Form 1040.
sources: IRS: Form 1040 is the individual income tax return; employers issue Form W-2; payers issue Forms 1099 for other income. (https://www.irs.gov/forms-instructions)

questions.prompt: Kayla has two W-2s from two jobs. How many should she use when filing?
questions.intro: Every W-2 and 1099 reports income that belongs on the return.
questions.feedback: All income must be reported, so both W-2s are used.
sources: IRS: Form 1040 is the individual income tax return; employers issue Form W-2; payers issue Forms 1099 for other income. (https://www.irs.gov/forms-instructions)

questions.prompt: Wages of $3,200 and $5,200 from two W-2s total how much?
sources: IRS: Form 1040 is the individual income tax return; employers issue Form W-2; payers issue Forms 1099 for other income. (https://www.irs.gov/forms-instructions)

questions.prompt: When should most workers expect to receive their W-2s?

choices.text: By early February (employers must send them by January 31)

questions.correct_answer: By early February (employers must send them by January 31)
questions.feedback: Employers must furnish W-2s by January 31.
sources: IRS: Form 1040 is the individual income tax return; employers issue Form W-2; payers issue Forms 1099 for other income. (https://www.irs.gov/forms-instructions)

sections.relationship: Totaling income from several forms adds amounts.

sections.skill: Reading a W-2 box by box

questions.prompt: A W-2 shows Box 1 wages $28,500 and Box 3 Social Security wages $30,000. Why might Box 1 be lower?

choices.text: Pre-tax 401(k) contributions reduce Box 1 but not Box 3
Box 1 is always half of Box 3

questions.correct_answer: Pre-tax 401(k) contributions reduce Box 1 but not Box 3
questions.intro: Box 1 shows wages subject to federal income tax. Box 3 shows wages subject to Social Security tax. Traditional 401(k) contributions lower Box 1 but not Box 3.
questions.feedback: A $1,500 pre-tax 401(k) contribution lowers Box 1 only.
sources: IRS: Form 1040 is the individual income tax return; employers issue Form W-2; payers issue Forms 1099 for other income. (https://www.irs.gov/forms-instructions)

questions.prompt: Box 3 Social Security wages are $30,000. What should Box 4 (Social Security tax withheld at 6.2%) show?
questions.intro: Box 4 shows the Social Security tax withheld: Box 3 wages × 6.2%.
sources: IRS: Form 1040 is the individual income tax return; employers issue Form W-2; payers issue Forms 1099 for other income. (https://www.irs.gov/forms-instructions)

questions.prompt: Box 5 Medicare wages are $30,000. What should Box 6 (Medicare tax at 1.45%) show?
questions.intro: Box 6 shows Medicare tax withheld: Box 5 wages × 1.45%.
sources: IRS: Form 1040 is the individual income tax return; employers issue Form W-2; payers issue Forms 1099 for other income. (https://www.irs.gov/forms-instructions)

questions.prompt: Which W-2 boxes show state wages and state income tax?
questions.intro: The bottom of the W-2 reports state and local wages and taxes.
questions.feedback: Boxes 16–17 report state wages and tax.
sources: IRS: Form 1040 is the individual income tax return; employers issue Form W-2; payers issue Forms 1099 for other income. (https://www.irs.gov/forms-instructions)

questions.prompt: Kayla's W-2 has the wrong Social Security number. What should she do?

choices.text: Change the number on the form by hand
Ask her employer for a corrected W-2

questions.correct_answer: Ask her employer for a corrected W-2
questions.intro: Employers issue corrected W-2s (Form W-2c) for errors.
questions.feedback: The employer must issue a corrected W-2 (W-2c).
sources: IRS: Form 1040 is the individual income tax return; employers issue Form W-2; payers issue Forms 1099 for other income. (https://www.irs.gov/forms-instructions)

questions.prompt: A college sends a student Form 1098-T. What does it report?

choices.text: Interest she paid on student loans during the year
Tuition and related expenses for education credits

questions.correct_answer: Tuition and related expenses for education credits
questions.intro: Form 1098-T reports qualified tuition and related expenses, which can help claim education credits.
sources: IRS: Form 1040 is the individual income tax return; employers issue Form W-2; payers issue Forms 1099 for other income. (https://www.irs.gov/forms-instructions)

questions.prompt: A payment app sends Form 1099-K. What does it report?

choices.text: Money sent to friends as gifts
Payments received through the app for goods or services

questions.correct_answer: Payments received through the app for goods or services
questions.intro: Payment platforms report payments for goods and services on Form 1099-K. Personal gifts and reimbursements between friends are not income.
questions.feedback: 1099-K reports business payments received through platforms.
sources: IRS: Form 1040 is the individual income tax return; employers issue Form W-2; payers issue Forms 1099 for other income. (https://www.irs.gov/forms-instructions)

questions.prompt: Which form reports dividends from a brokerage account?
questions.intro: Brokers send 1099-DIV for dividends, 1099-INT for interest, and 1099-B for sales.
sources: IRS: Form 1040 is the individual income tax return; employers issue Form W-2; payers issue Forms 1099 for other income. (https://www.irs.gov/forms-instructions)

questions.prompt: Which form reports a distribution from an IRA or 401(k)?
questions.intro: Retirement accounts send two common forms: Form 5498 reports contributions made to an IRA, and Form 1099-R reports money taken out (distributions).
questions.feedback: Retirement distributions are reported on Form 1099-R.
sources: IRS: Form 1040 is the individual income tax return; employers issue Form W-2; payers issue Forms 1099 for other income. (https://www.irs.gov/forms-instructions)

questions.prompt: Kayla receives no 1099 for $300 of babysitting income. Must she report it if she files?

choices.text: Yes; income is reportable even without a form
No; only income reported on a tax form counts

questions.correct_answer: Yes; income is reportable even without a form
questions.intro: Income is reportable whether or not you receive a form.
questions.feedback: All income is reportable, form or no form.
